newsitem.title: SPAIN: IADB to weigh modernising Pan-American Highway.
newsitem.headline: IADB to weigh modernising Pan-American Highway.

text.p: The Inter-American Development Bank has agreed with six Central American nations to investigate the costs involved in modernising the Pan-American Highway.

Officials from Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua and Panama agreed with the bank to study the prospects for financing, operating, maintaining and managing the project, and to evaluate its environmental impact, the IADB said in a statement released at its 38th annual meeting in Barcelona.

"Political and economic changes in the isthmus in the last few years have created the conditions for the rehabilitation, widening, and modernisation of the Pan American Highway, to be carried out with the help of the private sector," it added.
It pointed to moves towards liberalisation, economic opening and restructuring in the region and the increased confidence of foreign investors.

The nations involved are particularly concerned about modernising the customs systems and facilitating the movement of freight and passengers among the countries in the region, it added. --Caroline Brothers, IADB newsroom +34 3 424 2834
